allowed_headline_statements: Atherogenic lipid burden is confirmed and is the first thing worth acting on.
Inflammation is mildly elevated and needs one repeat measurement before interpretation.
prohibited_headline_statements: You should start or change a statin dose.

executive_synthesis.headline: Confirmed atherogenic lipid burden with an unresolved inflammatory signal.
executive_synthesis.what_is_certain: Lipid particle burden is measured and bounded.
executive_synthesis.what_is_not_certain: Glycaemic and inflammatory state are single-timepoint only.
executive_synthesis.what_happens_next: Two repeat measurements convert candidate signals into decisions.

confirmed_measurements_and_bounded_findi.title: Elevated atherogenic particle burden
confirmed_measurements_and_bounded_findi.correct_interpretation: ApoB and LDL-C are concordantly elevated on a single fasting panel.
important_bounds: Single fasting panel; no method bridging across laboratories.

confirmed_measurements_and_bounded_findi.title: Thyroid axis within bounded range
confirmed_measurements_and_bounded_findi.correct_interpretation: TSH is within range on a single morning draw.

candidate_or_unverified_signals.title: Possible post-prandial glucose excursions
candidate_or_unverified_signals.correct_interpretation: Suggested by a partial CGM wear window that does not meet the minimum interpretive threshold.
unresolved_validity_items: CGM wear window below the minimum required days.
candidate_or_unverified_signals.do_not_do_yet: Do not label this as insulin resistance.
candidate_or_unverified_signals.next_truth_test: 14 consecutive days of CGM wear with a paired meal log.

open_screening_findings.title: Mildly elevated hs-CRP of unknown cause
open_screening_findings.correct_interpretation: One elevated value cannot distinguish transient from persistent inflammation.
open_screening_findings.next_truth_test: Repeat hs-CRP in four weeks, away from acute illness.

not_established_or_not_supported.replacement: Isolated atherogenic lipid burden without confirmed glycaemic dysregulation.

repaired_driver_hierarchy.why_it_matters: It is the measured, modifiable contributor with the clearest downstream consequence.
repaired_driver_hierarchy.what_would_change_management: A repeat concordant panel, or an imaging correlate.

repaired_driver_hierarchy.why_it_matters: It changes how aggressively the lipid burden is treated if it persists.
repaired_driver_hierarchy.what_would_change_management: A second hs-CRP away from acute illness.

measurement_and_action_plan.truth_transition: Moves the glycaemic signal from candidate to confirmed or excluded.
